the SL–PFAM is a promising tool to be used for seakeeping analysis of complex marine vehicles.
the SL–PFEMS is a promising numerical tool for simulating the seakeeping of spray generating ships.

the SL–PFUM is a suitable method to perform seakeeping simulations with a high accuracy and a high computational efficiency.
the X-IVSA is a promising alternative for the time integration of the SL–PEM for seakeeping simulation.
the SL–PF EM is suitable for seakeeping simulation, but further developments are required to make it more competitive in this field.
